title: Combinatorial Euler-Sieve Identities, Hadamard-Poisson Flux Detection, and Conditional Nodal-Wall Identities for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Analyzes three constructions for Riemann's completed Xi-function and its canonical transverse Wronskian W(d,t) = 16 int_0^inf y sinh(2dy) I(y,t) dy, separating exact identities from structural obstructions: (1) the finite cubic-window Dirichlet identity for zeta(s)*E_X(s) on 1 <= N < (floor(X)+1)^3 versus complex zeros F_2(-1 +- i) = 0, strip divergence of P_{>X}(s), and Kronecker small-prime alignment; (2) the closed-form Poisson-Hadamard negative-lobe integral -arcsin(d/d_*) and Sylvester inertia jump on a pole-free entire two-zero perturbation as contrapositives of Lagarias's equivalence; and (3) conditional Cauchy-Riemann nodal-wall identities along I(d,tau(d)) = 0 alongside an explicit polynomial counterexample and the pure-imaginary root Phi(i*eta_0) = 0 at eta_0 = 0.319415... < pi/8.
